agent_investigate_rules/1715933/exclude_.rationale: The extracted data includes affiliate roll-forward disclosure rows as if they were additional holdings. These rows present beginning fair value, additions, reductions, realized/unrealized changes, and ending fair value for controlled and non-controlled affiliated investments; they duplicate positions already counted in the main schedule of investments. For the affected 2025-09-30 and 2025-12-31 quarters, the affiliated-roll-forward ending fair values exactly equal the conservation overshoot, so excluding those leaked disclosure rows reconciles fair value to the validated anchor without deleting real main-schedule positions.
